page.overview:
Who is Acan?

Acan was a blond-haired Human who worked as a courier. In 19 BBY, he was sent by Nirama to Hedrett on Cularin, to give a message to the Heroes of Cularin. He was killed shortly afterwards by the Trandoshan thugs, Grug and Gurg.
